headline: Indonesian Stock Exchange to Meet MSCI Following Market Downgrade Warning
summary: The Indonesian stock exchange scheduled a meeting with MSCI to seek clarity over a warning that could strip the country of its emerging-market status following a heavy market rout.
why: Potential index reclassifications by major providers like MSCI can trigger massive passive fund inflows or outflows, profoundly impacting emerging market liquidity.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: A potential loss of emerging-market status risks driving large-scale foreign capital outflows from local equities.

why_moved: A downgrade warning from index providers triggered intense selling pressure and a sharp drop in market capitalization, forcing emergency talks.
